seams.description: store parity boundary: YamlConfigStore must be a drop-in replacement for JsonConfigStore at the C1 interface; silent-divergence risks are key names, ConfigError message shapes, REQUIRED_KEYS semantics, and set/save persistence timing

omitted_kinds.reason: DA-1 keeps loader.py/cli.py on JSON: this stage deliberately adds no production wiring — YamlConfigStore is additive and unwired, so there is no seam wiring to integrate; the route stage performs the loader/cli swap as its own stage with its own wiring seam
evidence: S1 (parity boundary verified at interface level by T03's closure)

e2e_gates.scenario: parity matrix (S1): run the full A1 5-item parity matrix — get/set roundtrip, save persistence, as_dict shallow copy, missing-file ConfigError, REQUIRED_KEYS on both classes — against BOTH JsonConfigStore and YamlConfigStore; failure scenario: both stores on a nonexistent path raise ConfigError with the 'config file missing:' prefix, and a C2-shape roundtrip is identity

regression closure (S1): python -m unittest discover tests exits 0 with all pre-existing tests passing — loader/cli behavior unchanged (DA-1); failure scenario: any pre-existing test failure is a DA-1 violation and fails the gate

spike artifact acceptance (final_acceptance, A4): spike-reader-inventory.md exists, names deploy/check.sh with evidence, lists every reader found, and contains a 'Recommendation: Route A' or 'Recommendation: Route B' line followed by reasoning; failure scenario: an artifact missing the check.sh entry or the Recommendation line fails the gate
